question: Can the existing raw boss-loader/active-slot predicate recognize a positive episode on a public reference movie?
author: Lord Tom
decision: First run must complete exact movie frames and reproduce a Kraid or Ridley defeat flag transition. Only then repeat once in an independent process. Identical raw traces and summaries plus a prior loader/active-slot episode qualify a positive observer control. If a defeat occurs without the proposed predicate, retain the falsifier and inspect the decoder. No complete movie/defeat means no qualified positive control and no unchanged retry.
limits: External reference movie is observer qualification only; its inputs, states and routes never enter fresh search or controller learning.
FCEUX is an independent reference emulator, not QuickNES replay qualification.
Loader and attribute agreement do not by themselves establish damage or a stable enemy identity.
Only the script-advanced frames are counted exactly; any frontend setup before movie reset is additional and unmeasured.
defeat_transition: A previously live clear flag must rise in the matching boss area; power-on set bits do not count.
correction: One startup frameadvance yields at movie frame zero, then all movie frames increment exactly. New checked failures stop playback and request frontend exit. Preserve original failed F01 and the 20-call clock diagnostic. No predicate, inputs, horizon or outcome gate changed.
